|  | | Hi HN, I build Valin because my wife needed a way to search across all the saves and all the information she came across online - from recipes, books, children activities, vacation recommendations. She didn't want another AI subscription or another account to manage. Valin was born - an application that allows users to share to it (almost) any kind of contents from applications (videos, audio, links, papers, reels. etc) and it goes in and using on-device AI transcribes audio, extract key frames of the video, extracts text from the frames and shows Key Takeaways and Summary. This allow users to get an at-a-glance overview of what the save was about and it allows the application to cluster and to find similar saves on the device - to generate new collections or to automatically (if [...] shows Key Takeaways and Summary. This allow users to get an at-a-glance overview of what the save was about and it allows the application to cluster and to find similar saves on the device - to generate new collections or to automatically (if enabled) assign saves to existing collections. And in the end it allows the system to support a chat-like interface where users can quickly get the information they need, not just the save. I vibe coded it in the last 5 months and I'm pretty happy how it turned out so I wanted to share the TestFlight beta to see if its interesting or useful to other folks. Features - fully on-device: no cloud services, no AI subscription, no account needed. - supports videos, audio, pdf, images - supports applications: FB, Instagram, Substack, X, Reddit, TikTok, [...] Daniel

Valin was born - an application that allows users to share to it (almost) any kind of contents from applications (videos, audio, links, papers, reels. etc) and it goes in and using on-device AI transcribes audio, extract key frames of the video, extracts text from the frames and shows Key Takeaways and Summary. This allow users to get an at-a-glance overview of what the save was about and it allows the application to cluster and to find similar saves on the device - to generate new collections or to automatically (if enabled) assign saves to existing collections. And in the end it allows the system to support a chat-like interface where users can quickly get the information they need, not just the save.

# Valin: The Private AI That Remembers Everything You Save
## Channel: Valin
6 subscribers
10 likes

### Description
67 views
Posted: 2026-11-10
TestFlight Beta : 

For people who save videos, posts, articles and documents across apps and can't find them when they need them, Valin is the private memory app that understands what you save, down to what's said in a video, so you can find information you don't even remember saving. Unlike other AI bookmarking apps, Valin's AI runs entirely on your device, so only you can see what you save. 

No account, no cloud AI, no AI subscription. [...] ### Transcript
[0:00] Introducing Valon. Your private memory for everything you save. A wall light trick. A Lisbon viewpoint. Saved
[0:09] everywhere. Found nowhere. One place for every save with the details pulled out. Places, prices, even which tram to take.
[0:18] Next time you find something, just share it to Valon. That's the whole habit. Valon supports every kind of save.
[0:26] videos, articles, PDFs, photos, voice memos, and more, all in one library. For videos, it checks the frames,
[0:35] transcribes the audio, and reads the caption, all on your device. Weeks later, search the way you remember it,
[0:42] not the way it was titled, even the detail you forgot. The lamp arms reach 45 cm straight from the transcript. [...] [0:50] Valon groups related saves, suggests where new ones fit, and you decide what stays. And when the answer is spread
[0:57] across saves, just ask. Valon's ondevice AI pulls together three dinners with numbered sources to check.
[1:06] Private AI that lives on your device. No account, no tracking. Valon, find the things you saved and the details you forgot.
